lines.t: I was running with a broken heart
Chasing shadows in the night
Every promise that the world had made
Faded in the morning light
I was drowning in my failures Lost and tangled in my shame
Then your mercy found me weeping And you called me by my name
You took my chains and broke them You poured your love on me
You wrote a brand new story where my soul is finally free
Yahushua, my redeemer, you pulled me from the night
Yahushua, my salvation, you turned my darkness into light
Every breath is for your glory, every step I walk by faith
Yahushua, holy savior, I am covered by your grace
In the valley of the shadows
When the fear is closing in
You are singing over all my doubts
You remind me I'm forgiven
When the storms are all around me
And the waves are crashing loud
You are standing in the fire with me
You will never let me down
You took my scars and healed them, you turned my grief to praise
You filled my heart with courage for the rest of all my days
Yahushua, my redeemer, you pulled me from the night
Yahushua, my salvation, you turned my darkness into light
Every breath is for your glory, every step I walk by faith
Yahushua, Holy Saviour, I am covered by Your grace
You are the Lamb who was slain, the King who rose again
You are the truth and the way, the beginning and the end
Every nation, every tongue will bow before Your throne
Crying Yahushua, You alone
You alone are God
You are the fire in my spirit
The whisper in the wind
You're the song within my heartbeat
The one who lives within
Yahushua, oh-oh-oh-oh
Yahushua, oh-oh-oh-oh
Yahushua, oh-oh-oh-oh
Yahushua, oh-oh-oh-oh
Yahushua, my redeemer
You pulled me from the night
Yahushua, my salvation
You turn my darkness into light
Every breath is for your glory
Every step I walk by faith
Yahushua, Holy Savior
I am covered by your grace
Yahushua, my Redeemer
I am covered by your grace
